title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin advanced 3.2% into the US close, settling at $63,845 even as Fear & Greed remained locked at Extreme Fear of 23. Price action decoupled from sentiment while hashrate held steady at 819.9 EH/s and the mempool carried 92,806 transactions with fees at just 2 sat/vB. 

Key takeaway: buyers absorbed supply without needing euphoria. Block height reached 957,371 with no major disruptions. 

Overnight, watch whether the bid holds above 63k or if profit-taking emerges before Asian open.
